devicesMFE.py.summary: DevicesMFE is a UI page class that extends HPXFlow and provides verification methods for the HP devices micro-frontend (MFE) interface. It contains methods to verify various UI elements and states related to device management, including popups, navigation bars, printer information, supply levels, and device cards.

methods.method_description: Verifies the presence of the new HP app popup skip button

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Flag to determine whether to raise an exception if element is not found

methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement object for the new HP app popup skip button or None
methods.method_purpose: Waits for and returns the new HP app popup skip button element to verify the popup is displayed

methods.method_description: Verifies the home navigation by checking the app bar MFE

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the element
Flag to determine whether to raise an exception if element is not found

methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement object for the app bar MFE section or None
methods.method_purpose: Verifies the home navigation is present by delegating to verify_app_bar_mfe method

methods.method_description: Verifies the presence of a Windows dummy printer device in the list

method_input_parameter.parameter_purpose: Printer name to verify in the device list
Maximum time in seconds to wait for the element
Flag to determine whether to raise an exception if element is not found

methods.method_output_parameter: WebElement object for the Windows dummy printer device or None
methods.method_purpose: Waits for and verifies a dummy printer device using a recent device list XML file (alpha code workaround)

methods.method_description: Verifies that a Windows dummy printer has been removed from the list

methods.method_purpose: Waits for the dummy printer device to become invisible to verify it has been removed from the list
